title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall on 1970-01-10
lineage: Reel (Akai GX636) -> Apogee Mini-Me (24bit/96k) -> Apogee Mini-Dac -> Wavelab 5 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard capture (Miller 127228) with decent clarity, but the Jan ’70 show is mostly average aside from a standout Me & My Uncle.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑updated 127228 soundboard source offers good balance and image, fixing earlier pitch and mix problems. Musically the concert sits squarely in the early‑’70 “average” zone – a rushed set with few jam sequences, though Me & My Uncle shines and Black Peter is solid, while Mason’s Children feels uneven. Overall it’s a decent listen for completists but not a landmark performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is judged average/pedestrian (≈2.8 ★) while the updated soundboard recording is good (≈4 ★). Weighted 70/30 this yields about a 3.2‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller's updated 127228 source sounds much better than earlier versions; previous Miller 89862 had balance and image problems and other sources were pitched too slow.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set feels rushed with missing opening numbers, little jam sequencing, and an overall average early‑’70 vibe.
